about.text: a cheese named after the city of the same name in Portugal, the main city of the district where it is produced. The cheese is made from milk produced by either a goat or a ewe, and has a soft texture.

sources.text: Cardoon-set; about 40 days (goat) to 50 days (sheep), 40 days minimum; the longer-aged Amarelo da Beira Baixa is a separate PDO
